question: Will Bitcoin reach $67,500 in July?
resolution_criteria:
This market will immediately resolve to "Yes" if any Binance 1 minute candle for BTC/USDT during the month specified in the title (from 00:00 AM ET on the first day to 11:59 PM ET on the last), has a final High price equal to or greater than the price specified in the title. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No."

The resolution source for this market is Binance, specifically the BTC/USDT High prices available at https://www.binance.com/en/trade/BTC_USDT, with the chart settings on "1m" for one-minute candles selected on the top bar.

Please note that the outcome of this market depends solely on the price data from the Binance BTC/USDT trading pair. Prices from other exchanges, different trading pairs, or spot markets will not be considered for the resolution of this market.
research:
I couldn't confirm a Binance BTC/USDT high of $67,500 or more in July as of July 16-17, 2026. The highest July price I found was about $65,100 on July 14-15, and on July 16 BTC closed near $63,800. To reach the target it would need to rise about 5.8% before July 31, 11:59 PM ET.

## 1. Resolution source
- I couldn't retrieve Binance data: both the Binance API and the StatMuse page were refused by the proxy, so I have no Binance 1-minute high. All prices below are from aggregators (roughly USD index), not Binance BTC/USDT.
- 2026-07-16: StatMuse's daily figures were open $64,713, high $64,932, low $63,702, close $63,789. [StatMuse](https://www.statmuse.com/money/ask/bitcoin-price-day-by-day-july-2026)
- 2026-07-16: BTC opened at $64,720 (Yahoo Finance). Fortune had it at $64,055 at 5:45 a.m. ET. [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/personal-finance/investing/article/bitcoin-and-ethereum-prices-today-thursday-july-16-2026-prices-rise-ethereum-becomes-increasingly-compelling-124218108.html), [Fortune](https://fortune.com/article/price-of-bitcoin-07-16-2026/)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. The July high I found was about $65,100, roughly $2,400 (3.7%) below the target. Spot near $63,800 is about 5.8% below it.
- 2026-07-03: BTC opened at $61,493. [Biztoc/Yahoo](https://biztoc.com/x/663908b56c1f085c)
- 2026-07-06: BTC was about $61,935. [Fortune](https://fortune.com/article/price-of-bitcoin-07-06-2026/)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-07-16: Prices were slipping after the CPI spike. Yahoo's headline called Ethereum "increasingly compelling". [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/personal-finance/investing/article/bitcoin-and-ethereum-prices-today-thursday-july-16-2026-prices-rise-ethereum-becomes-increasingly-compelling-124218108.html)
- 2026-07-14/15: The June CPI report showed prices down 0.4% for the month, the biggest drop since April 2020. Annual inflation fell to 3.5%, against a 3.8% forecast. BTC jumped from about $62,000 to $64,900 within minutes and peaked near $65,100, its first move above $65,000 since June 22. Reports put resistance near $66,000. ETF outflows and US-Iran tensions were cited as headwinds. [Bitcoin Foundation](https://bitcoinfoundation.org/news/bitcoin/btc-price-july-15/), [Forklog](https://forklog.com/en/bitcoin-holds-above-65000-following-u-s-inflation-slowdown/?hl=en-US), [BeInCrypto](https://beincrypto.com/us-cpi-report-bitcoin-pump-or-dump-july-2026/)
- Early July 2026: US spot BTC ETFs had 8 straight weeks of net outflows, about $5.53B year to date, with more than $4B leaving in June alone. There was an inflow of about $221.7M on July 2. [KuCoin](https://www.kucoin.com/news/flash/bitcoin-etfs-record-5-53-billion-outflows-in-2026)
- 2026-07-02: BTC started the year above $93,000 but ended June around $60,000. [24/7 Wall St](https://247wallst.com/investing/cryptocurrency/2026/07/02/bitcoin-price-prediction-for-july-2026/)

## 4. Base rates
- June 2026 was down about 20.5%, the worst month of 2026. The trend is bearish, with a bounce from about $60,000 to $65,000 so far in July.
- Over July 1-16, the range was roughly $60,000-61,000 (low) to $65,100 (high), about 7-8% from low to high.
- To resolve Yes, BTC needs an intramonth high about 5.8% above the July 16 close, within about 15 days. Historically, BTC's maximum upside move over 2-week windows often exceeds 5-6%, especially after a month with about 20% swings. However, the $65,000-66,000 level has acted as resistance. I did not find a computed base-rate statistic.

## 5. Other forecasts
- A StartupHub piece about Polymarket's "What price will Bitcoin hit in July" market says $67.5k was the most heavily weighted level. Its numbers are inconsistent: one version says about 61.5%, another says 78.5%. I couldn't verify the timestamp or the live Polymarket price as of July 17. [StartupHub](https://www.startuphub.ai/news/bitcoin-price-bets-july-2026)
- A Polymarket mirror showed the $66,000 upside contract for July 6-12 at about 30%. [mirror](https://polymarkets.co.il/en/market/what-price-will-bitcoin-hit-july-6-12-2026/)
- 2026-07-02: Monthly outlooks were published by 24/7 Wall St and CryptoTimes. [24/7 Wall St](https://247wallst.com/investing/cryptocurrency/2026/07/02/bitcoin-price-prediction-for-july-2026/), [CryptoTimes](https://www.cryptotimes.io/2026/07/02/bitcoin-price-prediction-july-2026-will-btc-go-up-or-crash/)
- I found no Kalshi or Manifold price for this exact question.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- 2026-07-28/29: The FOMC meets, with the decision on July 29 at 2:00 PM ET. This is the main scheduled macro catalyst. After the soft CPI print, markets may watch for signs of rate cuts. [Babypips](https://www.babypips.com/analysis/event-guide-forex-us-fomc-statement-july-2026-07-29), [Fed calendar](https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/2026-july.htm)
- Ongoing: daily ETF flows and US-Iran geopolitical headlines.
- 2026-07-31 11:59 PM ET: the July window closes.
